title: Are you kidding me?
body:
I purchased the app some times ago and was happy using it although there are many things that can be improved. 

After some update (I don't know when because I hadn't used the app for a period of time), now I'm surprise that the app needs monthly or yearly subscription in order to continue using it? Worse, my previous entries were removed, all gone. Can't believe this. 

Really disappointed.

title: Poor Performance & Subscription
body:

It really upset me.

title: All-in-one Goals/Habits App
body:
This app offer an all-in-one solution whether it is goals tracking or habit forming.
Really love the simple and friendly UI.
Would have rated it 5 stars if it:
1. Offers a cloud sync over iOS devices.
2. Has backup function (might be include in 1.) and export data
3. Has an endless check-ins function for essential daily routines.

Keep going Strides team
